artworks.title: Vous voyez ... je viens de faire ... mon marché ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man riding a horse and interacting with two other men. The drawing shows a distinguished gentleman seated atop a horse, conversing with two onlookers. The horse is drawn with exaggerated proportions, while the rider is in elegant attire. The two onlookers have exaggerated features and postures, suggesting a comedic tone. The setting seems to be a street or public space based on the ground texture. The drawing uses strong lines and shading to emphasize the characters.

artworks.title: Mais on jouit d'une félicité pure
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of one person climbing a ladder against a tree, while another person stands below looking up. The scene includes vegetation, a fence, and a caption that adds a humorous or cautionary tone. The style is sketch-like with strong lines and shading.

artworks.title: Satanées salades ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a man watering plants. The man has exaggerated facial features, wearing a hat, glasses, and a suit. He is bending forward, watering plants with a watering can in hand. In the background are cartoonish trees, clouds, and a faint outline of another figure. The setting is outdoors, possibly in a garden, with sketchy depictions of plants and foliage.

artworks.title: Le bouquet
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an explosion of light in the sky. The drawing depicts a group of people looking upwards. The composition uses a contrast between light and shadow, emphasizing the radiance in the night sky. The glow illuminates the edges of the viewer's faces. The lines radiate outwards from the focal point in the sky.

artworks.title: Ah! Enfin voila le train! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing on a train platform facing the right side. They appear to be looking at an approaching train. Their positions convey anticipation, standing upright and leaning slightly forward. Three individuals in the foreground are noticeable: a woman wearing a bonnet and a long coat, and two men - one with distinctive facial features and a hat, the other also wearing a hat. They are among other people in period-appropriate attire. The platform has a visible roof, and the background shows rail tracks extending to a steam train in the distance, with steam creating a sense of movement.

artworks.title: La première lecon ... ; Un monsieur ... ; Collé sous bande; Deux amateurs de la banlieue
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a billiards scene with caricatured figures in a humorous setting. The artwork is a black and white illustration from "Journal Amusant", dated March 1865, and is titled "Les Joueurs de Billard" by H. Daumier. The upper panel shows two figures at a billiards table, one with a cue stick and the other giving advice. The lower panel shows a single figure focusing on striking the billiard ball while a crowd watches in the background. The composition is filled with comedic exaggerations typical of Daumier's style, with prominent facial features and fluid line work conveying a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Un divertissement qui ... de mode
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature sketch with three individuals in a humorous setting. A man with exaggerated features is on the left side, a woman with round face and unique attire is partly seated in the middle, and a person in a hat is adjusting a mechanical device. The background has a tent-like structure and trees.

artworks.title: Mossieu ... je suis ce mari aux dépens duquel
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing and facing each other. The man on the left has a stern expression, exaggerated facial features, and is wearing a tall top hat and a coat. The man on the right has a slender face and also wears a tall hat and coat. Another figure is partially visible between them, and some men in the background are similarly dressed. The background is a shaded texture with no specific details.

artworks.title: J'ai parlé ... trois heures et demie!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men dressed in legal or academic robes, standing and facing each other. The man on the left has prominent facial features with a pronounced nose, wrinkles on his face, and an expressive smile. He wears a dark robe with a white cravat or neckband and a tall, cylindrical hat concealing most of his hair. The man on the right also wears a dark robe and a similar hat but is viewed from the side, showing a side profile with a smaller nose and a slight smile. Both men are against a plain background with some visible text. The man on the left appears to be gesturing with his hand.

artworks.title: Une soirée d'allégresse a Clichy
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures reaching for a hat. The illustration depicts two individuals with outstretched arms reaching towards a hat thrown into the air. The expressions and movements suggest excitement and liberation. The scene includes scribbled text at the top and bottom. The style is lively with detailed facial expressions and movements.

artworks.title: Vois le cours de la bourse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing waist up. The man on the left holds a sheet of paper close to his chest. He has curly hair, a beard, and wide eyes. The man on the right is speaking and holding a tray with two glasses. He has short hair, a mustache, and wears a cap. In the background, there is a textured wall and a window frame.

artworks.title: Nude Walking with Cupid
artworks.medium: charcoal and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. One figure is standing and holding flowers with their left hand, while their right arm is extended downward. The figure has softly drawn facial features, gentle eyes, long, wavy hair partially covered by a headscarf or hood, and is draped with fabric from the waist down. Beside them, on the left side, is a smaller figure, likely a child or a winged cherub, shown in mid-step with wings and a gentle expression. The background includes loosely sketched foliage and trees.

artworks.title: Studies of Dogs and a Seated Boy [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of rough sketches within an oval shape. Various animal heads and a smaller, seated figure are depicted. The animals, resembling dogs, are each drawn in different angles and positions with unique expressions. The central part of the drawing is left blank, drawing attention to the detailed elements on the edges. Line work emphasizes textures like fur and fabric folds. The style indicates quick, observational studies on a single piece of paper.

artworks.title: High Street, from Ninth Street, Philadelphia
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1956)
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of High Street from Ninth Street in Philadelphia, viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon line is low, accentuated by the alignment of buildings that gradually recede into the distance. The scene includes a line of trees and buildings tapering into the vanishing point. The technique involves fine, linear brushstrokes seen in the detailing of the clouds and building texture. The color palette is subdued with earthy tones dominating, buildings in shades of brown and tan, and a light blue sky with hints of pink and gray. Figures and horse-drawn carts animate the street, including pedestrians and military individuals on horseback. In the distance, the street remains busy, suggesting a lively urban environment.

artworks.title: Simsbury, Connecticut
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Mrs. J.L.M. Curry, 1977)
artworks.description: This image shows a pencil drawing of a landscape with trees, hills, and grass. The horizon features a line of trees and hills, while detailed trees dominate the foreground. Various shades of grey and pencil strokes create texture and depth in the image. The drawing is monochromatic, with shading portraying sunlight and shadows. A faint path leads into the distance.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy; and the Entrance to a Shack
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This drawing shows a young person's profile and an interior view of a rustic structure. The sketched portrait is on the left, showing the shoulders and head of a young individual with curly hair, straight eyebrows, wide eyes, and a slightly downturned mouth. The person faces slightly to the left and wears a jacket with a tie or cravat around their neck. To the right of the portrait is a depiction of the interior of a wooden shed or cabin, characterized by rough lumber textures and various tools or items stacked against the walls. The two drawings are separate, and the background is blank, beige paper.

artworks.title: John Syng Dorsey, M.D.
artworks.artist: Charles Goodman and Robert Piggot, after Thomas Sully
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This portrait depicts a man seated in a three-quarters position, facing right. He has a youthful countenance, prominent cheekbones, closely set eyes, and styled hair with curls. He wears formal attire with a high-collar coat over a waistcoat and cravat typical of early 19th-century fashion. His right arm rests on a chairback, his hand delicately poised against a book or similar object. The background consists of finely stippled grey tones, contrasting with the subject's detailed rendering. An inscription identifies him as John Syng Dorsey, M.D., a professor of anatomy at the University of Pennsylvania.

artworks.title: Theodric Romeyn Beck, M.D.
artworks.artist: John Francis Eugene Prud'homme, after Robert Walter Weir
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated from the waist up. He is turned slightly to the left, with a serious expression. The man has a defined jawline, straight nose, and dark, wavy hair. He is dressed in formal attire, holding a book in his right hand and resting his left hand on his thigh near the book. On a table next to him, there is an inkwell with a feather quill. The background is plain and dark. Text at the bottom identifies the man as "THEODORIC ROMEYN BECK, M. D." with his signature.

artworks.title: The Voyage of Life: Childhood
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a small boat traveling on a stream. There is lush vegetation along the water's edge, leading to rocky formations in the distance. The horizon features soft clouds under an overcast sky. The artwork is detailed, with textures of rocks, plants, and water captured through brushstrokes or engraving techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily using shades of grey.

artworks.title: Vue general de l'Église St. Gervais et St. Protais à Gisors
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a bustling urban scene from a street level vantage point. A large Gothic church with ornate architectural details is on the left side. There is a receding street view with more buildings in the distance. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette with varying shades of grey and black. People are gathered in the foreground, while distant figures and structures are less clear in the background. The style of the image is similar to a lithograph, with fine lines and detailed etching used to convey texture. The composition is framed vertically with a light sky above the cityscape.

artworks.title: Justice
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The person is holding scales in one hand and a sword in the other. The facial features are delicate, framed by parted hair. The person wears a flowing gown cinched at the waist, without visible jewelry. The background is a textured shading. The image is labeled as "Justice" with the artists' names included.

artworks.title: Bavant pour se desennuyer
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two contrasting scenes involving drinking. The upper section shows a cafe or bar setting with individuals seated and being served drinks by a waiter. The lower section depicts a person and a cow drinking water from a fountain.

artworks.title: The Shore
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Albert R. Miller, Jr.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a coastline, sea, hills in the distance, waves, birds in the sky, meticulous brushstrokes, fine lines conveying textures of water and land, a monochrome color palette, sparse vegetation represented by vertical lines, and a simple hand-drawn frame around the composition.

artworks.title: Ships
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Albert R. Miller, Jr.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a slightly elevated view. The horizon is above the center with land on the right and smaller boats on the left. In the foreground, a sailboat with energetic strokes is prominent. Further back, more boats with triangular sails are on the water. The sketch-like drawing style uses dynamic ink lines for movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on aged paper, giving a simple and immediate feel.
